content.page_summary: Reference list focused on SGLT2 inhibitors in heart disease (dapagliflozin, empagliflozin) and on proton pump inhibitors (lansoprazole, omeprazole) including their interactions with antiplatelet agents (clopidogrel, prasugrel) and GI bleeding risks.

references.citation_brief: Solomon SD et al. Dapagliflozin in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction. N Engl J Med 2022
references.topic: SGLT2 inhibitor (dapagliflozin) in heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved EF

references.citation_brief: von Lewinski D et al. Empagliflozin in acute myocardial infarction: the EMMY trial. Eur Heart J 2022
references.topic: SGLT2 inhibitor (empagliflozin) in acute myocardial infarction

references.citation_brief: Harrington J et al. Empagliflozin in patients post myocardial infarction: rationale and design of the EMPACT-MI trial. Am Heart J 2022
references.topic: Empagliflozin trial design for post-myocardial infarction patients

references.topic: PPI (lansoprazole) to prevent aspirin-related ulcer complications

references.citation_brief: Casado Arroyo R et al. Lower GI bleeding more common than upper among patients on dual antiplatelet therapy: long-term follow-up. Heart 2012
references.topic: GI bleeding patterns in patients on dual antiplatelet therapy; PPI co-therapy

references.topic: Effect of a PPI (lansoprazole) on prasugrel and clopidogrel pharmacokinetics/dynamics
